result.title: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
result.summary: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. Existing task-specific models achieve convincing performance but require massive paired training images before and after translation. As advanced text-to-image (T2I) models have reached a practically usable level of multilingual text generation, we argue that this capability can be transferred to IIMT and present FlowTranslator. It is a training-free IIMT framework that first employs an OCR model and an LLM to generate the translation prompt, which is injected into the T2I-based diffusion model. To optimize the accurate and natural generation of translated text, we introduce two trajectory controls: Region Coupling Release (RCR) partially decorrelates target-branch noise inside the text region early in the trajectory, while Coupling Expansion (CE) amplifies the emerging edit displacement mid-trajectory. Under the EasyOCR read-back protocol, FlowTranslator achieves average PRIM BLEU and COMET scores of 20.6 and 57.2, respectively, substantially outperforming the strong training-based baseline UniTranslator. On the more challenging and realistic whole-image ScenePair photographs translated into Chinese, it reaches 40.1\% exact-match accuracy and surpasses existing editing systems, some of which only address the text-rendering stage rather than the complete IIMT task. These results establish flow-based editing as a strong, fully training-free baseline for IIMT.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的图内机器翻译框架 FlowTranslator，借助 OCR 与 LLM 生成翻译提示注入 T2I 扩散模型，并用两条轨迹控制策略提升文字区域的重绘准确性。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文目标是替换图像中的文字并保留视觉上下文，属于图像编辑与文字渲染任务；其轨迹控制针对像素级噪声去相关与编辑位移，未涉及 VLM 推理状态或 latent 证据使用，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
